name: Koenoem
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Oparemi, Saidat Olabisi 2011. Aspects of Koenoem Verb Phrase (Univ. of Ilorin long essay, grammar sketch; per Glottolog); no online copy found.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2019. Koenoem Android dictionary v1.0 (Dictionary App Builder APK), rogerblench.info.
sources.note: Unreadable: the lexicon and config assets inside the APK are encrypted (Dictionary App Builder); no plain-text introduction or phonology could be extracted.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page koen1239 and reference record 319915
sources.note: Bibliographic only: refs Hoffmann 1975 (subclassification), Oparemi 2011, Campbell et al. 2022, Lewis 2009; alt names Kanam, Korenoem.

sources.citation: Decker, Ken; Christina Riepe; Adedamola Aregbesola; Fittokka Gobak; John Sacson; Samuel Eju. 2021. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Koenoem [kcs] Language of Plateau State, Nigeria. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2021-021. Dallas: SIL International. 55 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Section 6.2 'Phonology' (printed p. 10-11) gives only 'initial, cursory observations' (consonant and vowel inventories, labialization/palatalization, vowel length); no mention of stress, accent or word-level tone. Appendix E (printed p. 34) states: 'The transcriptions are preliminary since there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features.' The 348-item wordlist is untoned.

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Koenoem language'; SIL record page for JLSR 2021-021 (sil.org/resources/archives/88818)
sources.note: Nothing on phonology; pointed to the SIL survey and to Blench 2006 AALIST and Blench 2017.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger & Michael Bulkaam. 2019. Belnəng, an undocumented Chadic language of Central Nigeria. Draft, Jos, 11 Nov 2019.
sources.note: Nothing about Koenoem: Koenoem appears only as a column in the comparative A.3 wordlist table; section 3.3 'Tones' describes Belnəng (three level tones), not Koenoem.
